title: Non-anchor 7-by-14 grid-layout row-edge prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares a source-context structural model from the registered Sanborn-papers archive snapshot before scoring any new observations. The source is archive-context-only, so it is not scored as evidence itself; it only fixes the 7-by-14 padded layout rule before future source-backed non-anchor positions are evaluated. This is not another pass over public-anchor additive fragments, candidate words, routed key material, or the existing row-boundary observation.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at predeclared 7-by-14 row-edge positions if a padded rectangular layout is structurally relevant.
discovery_inputs: Known-clue occupied positions for exclusion only
Context-only KryptosBot/Sanborn-papers rationale that 97 plus one padding character is compatible with a 7-by-14 rectangular layout
Predeclared row-edge rule emitted before observing or scoring future source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files that declare eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation
Source-backed position sets not used to construct the 7-by-14 grid-layout artifact
controls: seeded null over sampled non-anchor position sets of the same size
validate-grid-observations and evaluate-grid-prediction required before interpreting source-backed observations
multiple-comparison correction if interpreted beside period, spacing, or mirror families
archive-context-only sources cannot directly provide scored observation positions
